title: Model-agnostic predictability quantification of multivariable time series
abstract: arXiv:2610.33209v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multivariable time series forecasting plays an important role in various domains, where predictions depend on complex interactions among covariates. Forecasting models are commonly evaluated across numerous benchmark datasets. However, forecasting accuracy reflects both model capability and task predictability, making it difficult to characterise the difficulty of a task independently of the model used. Existing predictability measures often fail to capture nonlinear dependencies or are limited to univariate series. In this work, we propose Multivariable Predictability Score (MAPS), a model-agnostic metric for measuring the intrinsic predictability of multivariable time series forecasting tasks. MAPS uses covariate information to assess predictability across different lookback windows and forecasting horizons, and provides a quantitative assessment of the predictive information available for forecasting. translated_title: 多变量时间序列的模型无关可预测性量化
translated_abstract: 多变量时间序列预测在各个领域中发挥着重要作用，其预测依赖于协变量之间复杂的相互作用。预测模型通常在众多基准数据集上进行评估。然而，预测精度同时反映了模型能力和任务可预测性，这使得难以在独立于所用模型的情况下刻画任务本身的难度。现有的可预测性度量方法往往无法捕捉非线性依赖关系，或仅限于单变量序列。在本工作中，我们提出了多变量可预测性评分（MAPS），这是一种与模型无关的度量指标，用于衡量多变量时间序列预测任务的内在可预测性。MAPS利用协变量信息来评估不同回看窗口和预测时间范围下的可预测性，并对可用于预测的预测信息提供定量评估。我们在合成数据上对MAPS进行了评估……
tldr: 本文提出了模型无关的多变量可预测性评分（MAPS），通过利用协变量信息量化多变量时间序列预测任务的内在可预测性，解决了现有度量无法捕捉非线性依赖或仅适用于单变量序列的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MAPS, a model-agnostic score that leverages covariate information to quantify the intrinsic predictability of multivariable time series forecasting tasks, addressing the limitations of existing measures that fail to capture nonlinear dependencies or are restricted to univariate series.
